Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Bret Morrison is credited on 107 distinct recordings across 8 programs from 1936-09-28 through 1975-09-25. Documented roles include performer on 107 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Shadow (performer on 93 recordings; 93 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Mystery Theater (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), The Mysterious Traveler (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Inner Sanctum Mysteries (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Theater Five (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and X Minus One (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Lamont Cranston / The Shadow (91 portrayals).
